description.text: One of the two DP4 expansions released together on 26 October 2007, each made of different Pokémon, among them new and legendary ones. Moonlit Pursuit is led by the legendary Cresselia, and its wrapper is themed on the moon and the night. Cresselia, Garchomp and Honchkrow appear as LV.X. Its cards came out in English across Secret Wonders, Great Encounters and Majestic Dawn, between November 2007 and May 2008, most of them in Great Encounters.
